title: Refractory Installers
description:
About Us:

HSI is a leading manufacturing company. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and the highest quality standards. We are looking for Refractory Installation craftsmen to join our dynamic team, someone who shares our passion for delivering top-notch services that exceed expectations.

Job Information:

This position requires knowledge in refractory gunite, cast vibration, rammed refractory and/or ceramic fiber installations. Candidate should have experience in some or all of these refractory methods. Refractory Installers must be capable of performing demanding physical tasks in a variety of positions and under a wider variety of working conditions.

$2,000 sign-on bonus for qualified candidates, subject to eligibility requirements and company policy.

Candidate Requirements:

Installers should have 3 years or more craft experience, be able to operate a gunite machine, control installation by proper nozzle control, and trim to a proper finish.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary

  • Production bonus - based on attendance and safety record

  • Health, Dental and Vision Insurance available for employee and your family

  • 401(k) Savings Plan

  • Paid Holidays & Vacations

All employees are expected to be drug free and must pass a drug test before employment begins.
